howto.title: How to buy
steps: Choose a manga or ebook and tap Buy now.
Pick a payment method and send the exact amount.
Copy the transaction ID (TrxID or TXID) and paste it with your order.
The admin checks your payment by hand and confirms the order.
After confirmation, open your Library and start reading.

about.title: About MangaBooka
about.body: MangaBooka sells manga and ebooks, including dark psychology books, that you can read right on your phone. You buy a product once and it stays in your library.

items.a: No. You can buy without logging in. Just save your order code and secret. A free account makes your library available on every device.
Right after the admin confirms your payment. Nothing can be read before that.
Bangladesh: bKash and Nagad. Other countries: USDT on the BEP20 or ERC20 network.

items.q: What if I sent a little less?
items.a: Contact Support. The admin can confirm a small shortfall by hand.
Bengali, English, Japanese, Chinese, Malay and Spanish. Text inside manga pictures stays as it was drawn.

terms.title: Terms of use
items: Products are digital. Nothing is shipped.
Access starts only after the admin confirms your payment.
Content is for your personal reading. Do not copy, resell or share it.
The price shown when you place your order is the price you pay.
An order can be refused or cancelled if the payment cannot be verified.

privacy.title: Privacy
items: We keep only what is needed: your orders, your support messages and, if you sign up, your email.
We use your country to show the right currency and payment methods.
We do not sell your data.
Login is handled by Firebase Authentication. We never see your password.

refund.title: Refunds and problems
items: Digital products cannot be returned once access is given.
If a file or chapter is broken or missing, contact Support and we will fix it.
If your order is rejected, no access is given. Contact Support with your order code.
If you paid but the payment cannot be matched, Support will help you using the transaction ID.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Need help? Open Support from the menu. We reply inside the app.
